goal: rlo.pspec takes the three grammar fixes baseline accepted in BD-292 (P1 id seen, P2 fullmatch, P3 unknown template names), so check agrees with ga check_plan on all 17 cases and typos fail at load.

scope.text: P1: `id seen` means ids of earlier objects only. An object's `id new` is registered after its other fields are checked, so {"id":"a","after":["a"]} is rejected.
P2: `id new` and every regex `let` match with fullmatch, so "a\n" is rejected.
P3: a template name that is not an input, a `let`, `out`, `out_schema` or a loop variable (with its attributes) is a load error with line and column.
Nothing else changes. The section 4 numbers must stay the same: verbatim 12/12 and tokens 646->447 / 2263->1574. P4 is docs only and P5 is deferred.
